Chapter 1367 - 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’S Transformation

Chapter 1367: Chapter 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’s Transformation

The power of the light crystal is completely restrained.

But any being of time can sense the terrifying aura it contains.

Compared to the dark crystal formed by the Black Demon body, the light crystal is much more terrifying.

"Teacher..."

The thirteen Eternal Lords had complex thoughts.

The complexity of their thoughts came from two aspects.

Firstly, the Lord of Heaven Light had shown them favor before.

Secondly, even a powerful figure like the Lord of Heaven Light, at the level of a Lord, in pursuit of ultimate transcendence, to evolve into a Perfect Time Being, ended up with a destroyed spirit and will.

As First Realm time beings, could they still see hope?

"The disaster of magic is over."

Lin Yuan put away the light crystal and said, looking at the Eternal Lords.

In fact, as long as one can completely master the lordship of the Lord of Heaven Light.

One could easily reclaim the Black Demon body and the Light body.

This was the last safeguard left by the Lord of Heaven Light for his two true bodies.

"Yes, the disaster of magic is over."

The Master of Infinite murmured, simultaneously glancing at the distant Fang Yuan World.

Since the great changes in heaven and earth many eons ago.

The thirteen Eternal Lords were forced to leave their homeland world, until now.

"Congratulations, Galaxy, for becoming the new Eternal Lord."

The Master of Wushan spoke in congratulations.

As soon as these words were spoken.

The remaining twelve Eternal Lords also reacted.

Immediately, they spoke their congratulations one after another.

Although the Fang Yuan World lost the Time Lord, the Lord of Heaven Light.

It gained Lin Yuan, a time being with even more incredible potential.

Lin Yuan smiled and responded to each in turn.

"Galaxy, how strong are you now?"

The Master of Infinite looked at Lin Yuan, his expression inevitably curious.

Lin Yuan, having stepped into the thirteenth level, successively dealt with the Black Demon body and Light body of the Lord of Heaven Light.

He didn’t show much strength, mainly relying on the safeguards left by the Lord of Heaven Light, forcibly suppressing with the lordship.

Thus, the Eternal Lords were somewhat curious about Lin Yuan’s strength, though they had their theories in mind, they couldn’t quite believe them.

As for observing the future timeline?

Before Lin Yuan stepped into the thirteenth level, with the blessing of the lordship, his personal timeline had already become obscure and twisted to First Realm time beings.

Revealing little useful information.

Now, having become a time being, fully mastering the lordship, observing Lin Yuan’s future timeline is nearly as difficult as observing a true Time Lord.

According to Lin Yuan’s future timeline shown before he condensed the lordship.

It was vastly different from the scene just now.

The initial future seen by the Eternal Lords indeed showed Lin Yuan ending the magic disaster.

But it was nowhere near as relaxed and comfortable as it is now.

Evidently, Lin Yuan’s future had greatly diverged from what the Eternal Lords had originally seen.

"My strength?"

Lin Yuan smiled slightly, "Who wants to give it a try?"

"I’ll go." The Master of Black Space stepped forward, looking at Lin Yuan with anticipation.

Among the thirteen Eternal Lords, the Master of Infinite was the most powerful, with the Master of Black Space being the second only to the Master of Infinite.

In fact, in terms of defensive capabilities, he wasn’t weaker than the Master of Infinite.

Lin Yuan nodded: "I will use my suppressing techniques, feel it carefully."

The Master of Black Space was solemnly prepared.

The next moment.

Black and white yin-yang energy intertwined, enveloping this spacetime, the expression of the Master of Black Space changed, feeling the suppressive restraint of the black and white yin-yang energy on him.

Buzz!

The Master of Black Space’s form gradually vanished, transforming into a spacetime black hole, resisting the erosion from the black and white yin-yang energy.

Yet the black and white yin-yang energy continued to condense, vaguely forming a magnificent Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram, and no matter how much the Master of Black Space resisted, the yin-yang energies still began to permeate the spacetime black hole, sweeping towards his true form.

"Can’t hold it, can’t hold it at all."

The Master of Black Space’s mind trembled slightly, his path was best at defense, but he couldn’t withstand Lin Yuan’s suppression.

"If you feel something off, say it immediately, and I’ll stop." Lin Yuan said with a smile, also observing the path of the Master of Black Space.

Each Eternal Lord’s path was unique, to become a Time Lord, meant their path was powerful, but those time beings who hadn’t yet become Time Lords, their paths may not necessarily be weaker.

"Galaxy, stop it."

The Master of Black Space immediately shouted.

Though it was some distance from harming his true form.

But to start with such overwhelming force to penetrate his layered defenses, there was no need to continue resisting.

"Just with suppressing techniques, it’s already this terrifying, Galaxy, your strength might have already reached the Second Realm, right?" The Master of Infinite confirmed his hypothesis, looking at Lin Yuan with amazement.

Having just become an Eternal Lord, his combat power was akin to the Second Realm.

Once he stabilizes his realm, wouldn’t he be approaching the peak of the Second Realm, nearing a Time Lord?

It’s known that the strength of a newly ascended Eternal Lord isn’t very strong, leaving ample room for growth.

"Second Realm?"

The Eternal Lords glanced at each other.

They were all quite far from the peak of the First Realm, let alone the Second Realm.

"Black Space, Galaxy held back, only using suppressing techniques, if it were offensive techniques, you wouldn’t have the chance to call out to stop." The Master of Wushan said with a smile.

He had already received a lot of information from within the trial space, knowing that before Lin Yuan became an Eternal Lord, the Chaos Tai Chi Sword gathered with black and white yin-yang energy had an offensive power far beyond the Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram.

The Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram mainly served for suppression and restriction.

"I wouldn’t even have the chance to call out to stop?" The Master of Black Space muttered to himself.
